clusters.pick_reason: #2215 introduces a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper that applies the same /\/+$/ trailing-slash regex as #2214's fix, so it covers the same input-sanitization case. #2215 additionally updates shouldAttemptFallback's root-path check from pathname === '/' to pathname === '' to match the new normalized output — without that companion change, stripping all trailing slashes (as #2214 does to buildWellKnownPath/buildDiscoveryUrls) turns a root pathname of '/' into '', which the unmodified shouldAttemptFallback no longer recognizes as root, causing redundant fallback attempts. #2214 is labeled a chore and only touches the two path-building call sites, leaving that consequential fallback-logic mismatch unaddressed; #2215 is titled as the targeted fix for exactly that root-path fallback bug and carries the normalization as part of a more complete change.

clusters.pick_reason: 2763 ships a changeset (semver + changelog entry) documenting the fix; 2817 has none. 2763's changeset states its fix covers both the no-progress case (initial timer arm capped via Math.min(timeout, maxTotalTimeout)) and the progress-reset case ('progress resets re-arm against the remaining budget'), i.e. it addresses the same reset-path bug 2817 targets plus the initial-arm gap that 2817's diff doesn't touch. 2817's change is a single-line startTime update in the reset path only, with no changeset and no handling of the initial-arm cap, so on its own it leaves the originally reported hard-cap-ignored scenario ({timeout:1000, maxTotalTimeout:150}) unfixed.
